q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

(A) Each of these fields contributes to our understanding of the world in unique ways.
(B) Human knowledge is vast and constantly evolving across disciplines.
(C) While science explains the laws of nature, literature explores the depths of human experience.
(D) History, on the other hand, helps us interpret the lessons of the past.
q_hi:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

(A) Each of these fields contributes to our understanding of the world in unique ways.
(B) Human knowledge is vast and constantly evolving across disciplines.
(C) While science explains the laws of nature, literature explores the depths of human experience.
(D) History, on the other hand, helps us interpret the lessons of the past.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The correct sequence is 3 (B – C – D – A). Sentence (B) is the generic opening statement that introduces the main theme of 'Human knowledge'. Sentence (C) expands on this theme by detailing specific fields (science and literature). Sentence (D) uses the contrast connector 'on the other hand' to transition to another discipline (History). Sentence (A) concludes perfectly by summarizing all 'these fields'.

Solution (HI):
सही अनुक्रम 3 (B – C – D – A) है। वाक्य (B) एक सामान्य परिचयात्मक कथन है जो मुख्य विषय 'मानव ज्ञान' की शुरुआत करता है। वाक्य (C) विशिष्ट क्षेत्रों (विज्ञान और साहित्य) का विवरण देकर इसे आगे बढ़ाता है। वाक्य (D) विपरीत योजक 'on the other hand' का उपयोग करके इतिहास को जोड़ता है। अंत में, वाक्य (A) 'these fields' का उपयोग करके सभी क्षेत्रों का निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत करता है।

Short Trick:
Sentence B acts as an introduction. The phrase 'on the other hand' in D indicates it must follow another sentence describing specific disciplines, making the C-D link mandatory.

q_en:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains an error and select the option that rectifies it.

She said that she seen the movie before it was released in theatres.
q_hi:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains an error and select the option that rectifies it.

She said that she seen the movie before it was released in theatres.
solution:
Solution (EN):
The correct option is 1. The sentence reports two past actions: 'seeing the movie' and 'the movie being released'. The action that happened earlier in the past must be expressed in the Past Perfect Tense ('had + past participle'). Therefore, 'seen' must be rectified to 'had seen'.

Solution (HI):
सही विकल्प 1 है। वाक्य में भूतकाल की दो घटनाओं का संदर्भ है: 'फिल्म देखना' और 'सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होना'। जो घटना भूतकाल में पहले घटित हुई हो, उसे Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') में होना चाहिए। इसलिए 'seen' को 'had seen' में बदला जाएगा।

Short Trick:
When two related events happen in the past, the older event always uses 'had + third form of verb'.

Short Trick:
Sentence B mentions 'curious' → Sentence C immediately links with 'Such curiosity'. This B-C pair is only found at the start of option 1.

The correct option is 1. According to the foundational syntax laws of question tags, a positive declarative statement requires a matching negative question tag. Since the main clause contains 'You are...', the correct tag inversion is 'aren't you?'.

Solution (HI):
सही विकल्प 1 है। क्वेश्चन टैग के मूल नियमों के अनुसार, यदि मुख्य कथन सकारात्मक (positive) हो, तो उसके साथ हमेशा नकारात्मक (negative) टैग जुड़ता है। चूंकि वाक्य 'You are...' से प्रारंभ हुआ है, अतः इसका सही क्वेश्चन टैग 'aren't you?' होगा।

Short Trick:
Positive statement ('are') → Negative question tag ('aren't you').
